decision: W10-D1: block size of the PROT-phase high-level fraction (core E_prot fit), chosen on week 9 B5 data before any week 10 E_prot session
method: per P1 cycle: D1-only samples, mean per block of b samples (10 us each), fraction of blocks above week9_ppk2.HIGH_LEVEL_UA = 3600 uA; core = intercept of E_prot = a + b * fraction (week9_figures.core_fit) per session
criterion: smallest session range of the core E_prot over the three B5 sessions
note: week 9 reported the per-sample (b = 1) core 14.9 uJ; that number stays in the week 9 report. b = 1 counts single-sample transients; week 10 uses b = 5 (50 us) for E_prot core in every s.
